findings.title: check-streaming subject selection not stated
findings.fix: check-streaming uses the first --n-subjects subjects in find_subjects order (after --subjects-file); fewer available -> exit 2.

findings.title: no documented procedure if the float32 gate trips on real weights
findings.fix: Script header / report: on exit 4 inspect check_streaming_f32.json; localised or magnitude-dependent differences = engine bug; uniform slightly-above-bound = rounding, resubmit with --tol-* from measured numbers and record them; never drop the gate.
